name: BCS Junk Removal
summary: A 15-yard dumpster with rear double doors. The company says it fits in one parking space. Serves College Station, Bryan, and nearby towns including Navasota, Brenham, Caldwell, Somerville, and Iola.
accepted: Terms say any non-flammable junk. Tires are accepted on junk removal jobs for $10 each.
prohibited: Brush and hazardous waste. If you are not sure, call before you load.
gaps: Included tons on the dumpster rental (the dump fee is per ton)

junkRemoval.summary: Junk removal prices from the company's own pages, checked Nov 19, 2026. The company says online prices can change with the job.
